name: Horseradish
description: Fiercely pungent root grated raw — the heat goes up the nose, not down the throat.

tcm.note: The mustard-family pungency is hot and strongly dispersing.

ayurveda.note: Katu and ushna in a high degree.

unani.note: Garam-khushk; a classical drug for cold phlegm.

histamine.note: Low, though the pungency irritates independently of histamine.

nutrition.highlight: the heat goes up, not down
